༄༅/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po ni/ /bla

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi

dmar khrid bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po ni/ /bla ma dam pa la btud de/ /man ngag yongs su bri bar bya/ /tshe 'di nyid la mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bde chen 'bras rab stsol byed pa/ /gzhan du bstan bya ma yin pas/ /'di ni skal ldan nyid la 'os/ /'dir grub chen sha ba ri'i zhal gdams/ grub thob slob dpon rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug dpa' bo zhes bya ba'i gzhung lugs rdzogs pa'i rim pa man ngag gsum pa 'di nyams su len pa la gtum mo dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba gang rung re byas la/ tha mar 'od zer bsdu ba dang*/ thog mar sngags kyi ting 'dzin gnyis sbyar ba dang*/ gtum mo/ dga' ba 'khyil ba/ 'od zer bsdu ba/ re res kyang chog par bzhed pa dang*/ thams cad rim can du bsgoms pas lam rdzogs par 'dod pa gsum las bdag gi rdo rje slob dpon phyi ma 'di bzhed do/ /sngags kyi ting 'dzin 'di yang thog mar gzhi'i tshul tu sgom pa dang*/ re re bzhin du thog mar rdzogs rim sgom la sngags kyi ting 'dzin gyis bogs phyung nas/ ngo sprod pa sogs phyag len du mdzad do/ /sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin la rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes kyang zer ro/ /de dag sgom pa'i lag len ni 'di ltar yin te/ dang po bsags sbyangs dang lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs/ de nas rang phag mor lam gyis bsgom pa'i dang por phag gdong gi sna dang*/ de nas mig dang*/ gdong dang*/ rna ba 'phyang ba dang*/ mche ba dang*/ kha dog sngon po dang*/ rtsa zhal gyi shangs dang*/ zhal dang*/ mche ba'i myu gu dang*/ spyan gnyis dang*/ spyan dbus ma dang*/ snyan dang*/ skra mtshams dang*/ dbu skra dang*/ mkhur tshos dang*/ 'gram pa dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ zhal ras byings dang*/ phyag bzhi ka la re re dang*/ nu ma re re dang*/ sku stod dang*/ sked skabs phra ldem dang*/ lte ba dang*/ bha ga dang*/ ro smad dang*/ zhabs re re dang*/ sku mdog dmar ser dang*/

ro dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ padma dang*/ ba spu gyen la lta ba dang*/ dbu rgyan dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ mgo phreng dang*/ me tog phreng dang*/ me dpung dang*/ phyag mtshan re re dang*/ sku ril po ste de rnams la zhag re re sbyang ngo*/ /rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal la zhag bco lnga bslab/ nga rgyal dang gsal snang gnyis ka sbrags nas zhag bdun nam zla ba gcig tsam bslab bo/ /de nas rje btsun ma'i bris sku dang*/ mchod yul rnal 'byor mar sgom pa dang*/ gnas khang dang*/ bla ma sogs dang*/ pha ma dang gnod byed dang*/ chags yul dang*/ snying du mi sdug pa rnams sems can thams cad dang*/ snod thams cad la zhag gsum gsum mam re re bslab/ de nas re zhig rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin sgom ste/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la che re lta zhing grim gyi bsgrims pa'i 'dun pa tsam ma gtogs ci yang mi sems par bzhag /rnam rtog thol skyes na 'phro bcad nas sems rig ge ba 'di la cher re blta ba re byas nas bzhag go /gal te 'di gal che bas don 'di la mno bsam byed dgos snyam pa byung na bdud yin/ de ma thag gzhom dgos gsung*/ gang la'ang thug phrad du gtad med yang yud du bya/ rnam rtog shas che zhing da dung 'dzin pa dam na rig pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par gtan la phab cing*/ phab pa re re'ang mthar dmigs med snga ma lta bus zin par byas nas sgom/ de la zla ba tsam bya gsung*/ 1 de nas re zhig rdzogs rim sgoms la phyis rdo rje sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dug dbyung ngo*/ /rang gi lte bar chos 'byung dmar po sor gsum pa de'i nang la dbu ma zug pa'i nang du/ gtum mo sor gang tsam dbus su baṃ dang bcas pa sgom nas rlung kha sbyar khyad par bshang lam bsdams pas thur sel drangs/ chos 'byung g.yon skor du 'khor ba/ shin tu drag pa la sems bzung*/ 2 baṃ las me rlung shugs drag dbu ma nas byung sna sgo nas thon sor bcu gnyis kyi bar snang la dga' 'khyil yod pa la phog pas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba sgom/

rlung sbyor ba 'jam pos bum can bya gsung*/ 3 de nas sor brgyad tsam dang*/ sor bzhi tsam dang*/ 4 sna rtse la rag tsam dang*/ sna rtse'i nang du 'khor ba/ 6 rnams la zhag drug drug go /yang sna nang du 'khor ba 'di gegs chung la phan yon che bas zla ba tsam byas na yang legs/ de nas gtum mo dngos ni/ dbu ma'i nang gi lte bar chos 'byung sor phyed pa gtum mo skra rtse ltar phra ba sor gang sgom/ /'di man ngag ni lte 'og sor bzhir byed gsung*/ de ltar na nyin re bzhin nam/ de tsam ma lcogs na thun re re la me sor re re ring du spar ro/ /rtsa thams cad gsal sal mthong ba dang*/ 'khor lo re re'i bar bkag phug pa na de las rgyud pa'i rtsa thams cad mes gang bar sgom/ de ltar sor lnga bcus spyi bo'i haṃ la reg cing phug par sgom/ de dag tu rlung stod du 'tshangs na/ 'og rlung lte ba man chad du bsdams/ de la steng rlung yang yang brdeg pa nang gi gtun shing dang*/ brla khul nas brgyud lag pa gtan la btsugs nas lus 'degs shing brdabs pa phyi'i gtun shing ste/ smad kyi ba spu nas du ba lta bu'i rlung mthon pa'am/ bshang sgo dang gsang ba dang gang na sa nas mngon pa sogs ci rigs pa yod do/ /yang brla steng du rkang pa gcig shos bzhag nas dal bus ldang yang bsdad/ yang ldang ba lan gsum byas te/ mthar lus thams cad la phur mnye bya/ de nas g.yas g.yon du phar 'gyel tshur 'gyel bya ba ljon pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes so/ /yang phyag rgya'i mkha'am rang gi lag gis rdo rje dbab pa ni/ 'di'i bogs 'don dang*/ gtum mo shin tu goms pa'i gegs sel yang yin gyi da lta mi mkho zhing*/ 'phral du gnod pa yod/ de yang 'od kyi 'khor lo dpag tshad tsam mgo bo la bskor zhing steng du 'gro ba dang*/ glog gi dbyug pa mthong ba dang*/ brgyal shing spyi bor phug pa la/ rtsol ba klong nas sbyor ba des gegs sel bar snang gsung*/ de nas haṃ las byang sems kyang thun re la sor gang tsam re 'bebs shing ba thag lta bu dbu ma nas 'jug cing*/

gzhan rtsa thams cad gang bar bsam ste/ 'khor lo bzhi so sor phyin pa na dga' ba bzhi skye zhing*/ gal te ma skyes na myong ba dran nas mos pa bya/ 'di la dang por mun nag tu 'dug la rtags snang dmigs kyi bar du lte 'og tu sgom/ rtags snang lnga pa dmigs nas me spor lugs snga ma ltar byed pa dang*/ rtags snang dmigs rung ma dmigs rung de yan chad de ltar byas nas/ de nas rlung thengs re la lte rlung lte la 'og rlung la brdabs pas/ yar thabs su dbu mar zhugs nas me yud kyi spar/ byang sems yud kyi zhu/ lte ba'i gtum mo dang 'dres pa'i bde ba la sems rtse gcig tu byed pa goms pas rtags lnga dang 'gog pa'i rdo rje 'byung*/ yon tan brgyad tshan gnyis 'thob ste/ spyod pas bogs phyung bas tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yin gsung*/ me dmigs kyi gtum mo'i rim pa'o/ /da ni 'di las kyi gtum mo yin gsung ste gtso bor ni yin la/ mtha' gcig tu ma yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo yang yod pas so/ /de la rim pa 'di la gsum/ rang bzhin gyi gtum mo/ rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo/ las kyi gtum mo gsum las/ dang po ni sngar gyi gtum mo dang rim pa 'di'i gtum mo phyi ma gnyis dang*/ 'od zer bsdu ba rnams la shin tu goms pas g.yas g.yon dang srog thur 'dres pa brtan por song*/ de nas khams 'od gsal du thim pas rlung sems tsam gyi dkyil 'khor grub nas de'i phyag rgya dang*/ snyom par zhugs gtum mo sbar bas thob pa'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba lugs 'byung lugs ldog brtan par byas pas/ tha mal pas lus zad nas rdo rje'i skur 'gyur ro/ /las kyi gtum mo ni las kyi phyag rgya dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i lam yin te/ 'di skabs tha mal gyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par gyi phyag rgya'i brtags thabs/ gnod sbyin mo sogs bsgrubs pa/ phyag rgya dgug pa/ sbyor thabs sgom tshul/

gnad bzhi dang thor bu ba'i zhal gdams kyang mang du yod par snang*/ ci rigs ni bka' drin du'ang thob mod/ rnam rtog shas che ba 'ga' zhig gi dbang las/ kha cig ma nod pa yang yod pas ma spros so/ /rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo la brten pa ni 'di yin ste rang he ru ka dang ye shes kyi rig ma'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyom par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje'i gtum mo sbar ba'am/ rang rnal 'byor mar sgom nas rlung gnyis rtse sprad pas gsang ba'i gtum mo sbar bar sgom pa gdams ngag yin cing gang ltar gsang ba nas thig le dmar po las me khyug gis song*/ khu ba'i rtsa nas zhugs/ lte ba'i gtum mo dang 'dres/ dbu ma'i lam nas song*/ ba spu nas me'i zer phyir spros lha dang lha min sogs thams cad bsregs/ me lce spyi bo'i thig le la reg reg 'dug /rtsa nang gi byang sems thams cad zhu/ spyi bo'i rtsa rgyud kyi byang sems thams cad haṃ las brgyud nas babs/ de bzhin du 'khor lo bzhi kar song nas gong ma rnams 'og ma dang 'dres/ lte ba yan chad du brtan par byas/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma yungs 'bru tsam dkar po 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba dga' ba 'khyil ba'i rnam pa nor bu'i nang gi rtse'am/ bya gdong gi rtse mor khor khor 'khor bas/ bde ba bzod dka' ba chil chil ba la sems bzung*/ yang de las lhan skyes 'dren cing*/ de shin tu brtan na dang por nor bur phub/ de yar drangs te rim gyi sor re re steng de/ mthar spyi bor 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mas brtan gyi lhan skyes 'char ba yin/ de yang brtan na 'od zer bsdu ba sgoms pas 'od gsal dngos la 'jug par 'gyur/ de yan chad du mtshan mo'i nyams len ji ltar bya ba ni dang por gtum mo sgom pa'i skabs thig le lte bar phyin pa yan chad du ched gnyer mi byed/ de nas lte ba'i thig le 'dres pa'i bde ba la sems bzung ba'i ngang nas gnyid logades gnyid mthug po bde bar chud gsung*/

de man chad du nyin mo gang la goms pa'i rgyun de nyid la 'phen pa shugs cher bcug ste gnyid dus su 'khyer/ gal te rmi lam bzung 'dod na me dmigs kyi me dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba'i thig le mgrin par sgom la rmi lam yin snyams du byas pas zin 'ong*/ de nas gnyid dus su lhar bsgom snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang dmigs pa sbyong*/ de nas gnyid kyi skabs su rmi lam zin/ nyin mo'i dmigs pa dran nas thams cad lha skur 'byongs shing*/ der gtum mo dang*/ 'od zer bsdu ba dga' ba 'khyil ba gang sgom pas kyang rmi lam gyi lha skur slar yang 'od gsal du 'jug /de ltar na gnyid thun gcig gi nang du yang ldang 'jug yang yang nus gsung*/ 'od zer bsdu ba thog ma'i skabs su sgom na yang*/ de dag dang 'dra la/ dang por gzhan la goms nas de nas lam re mthor song ba'i skabs ni 'phen pa btang nas stong par bsdus pa'i ngang la ring du 'jog /der sems mi gnas na skad cig gis lhar bskyed la yang yang sbyang ngo*/ /gnyid du 'gro khar yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /dga' ba 'khyil ba 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /'di ni rjes zhig gi rim pa yin te/ dbu ma'i nang gi lte snying gang rung du kṣuṃ ljang khu sgom/ de las sna g.yas nas 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ de dag thams cad sna bu g.yon nas zhugs kṣuṃ la thim pas thig le sran ma tsam baṃ yig dang bcas pa'am/ nā das mtshon par gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus kyang nang gi rlung 'od zer gyi tshul du bsdus/ thig le la thim/ sku yang yal/ baṃ dang thig le nā da'i bar du bsdus nas stong pa la ring du bzhag /de nas yang lhar ldang*/ de'i mtshon pa'i snang ba gang snang yang lhar sgom pa ni 'od zer bsdu ba zhes bya ste ldang 'jug 'di yang yang sgom mo/ /'dir nyams kyi khrid pa ci rigs pa la/ 'od zer bsdu ba'i tshan bdun po re re la zhag drug drug bya/ de rnams song ba'i rjes su slar lam gyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du sgom dgos so/

/de dag tu nyams ci rigs pa skyes na/ dug dang bral ba ste/ de nyid sems dang gcig gam tha dad nyams sna tshogs dang*/ khyad par bde ba nam shar dus de nyid yang yang btsal/ gzhan yang de'i tshe skyo ba dang dga' ba nyon mongs ci skyes thams cad legs par btsal/ mthar gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngo bo la 'jog tshul/ bde ba'i rtsal dang*/ rig pa'i 'char sgo ma 'gags pa de nyid rtag tu bskyangs shing*/ phyogs med du sbyong*/ gang snang thams cad de ltar ngo 'phrod par bya'o/ /gtum mo'i me nang dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba'i thig le'i nang dang*/ kṣuṃ gi thig le'i nang du lha sku thig le sogs skyed chog ji lta bar sgom/ yang de'i nang du gtum mo dang*/ lha sku la sogs pa thug med du sgom ste/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim phan tshun rgyas 'debs pa yin gsung ste/ phyogs 'dra ba yin no/ /go don ni gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid lag len rdzogs so// //bde ba'i 'jug ngogs rmad du byung*/ /shin tu myur ba'i man ngag ni/ /tshe 'dir byang chub 'grub nges pas/ /thob pa 'di la dga' bar byos/ /de skad kyang gsung ngo*/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa dam pa rje btsun dpal stag lung thang pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ bla ma dam pa kun dga' bkra shis kyi bka' stsal spyi bos nod de tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la bris/ /zhu dag/ maṅga laṃ shubha wastu// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag gi dmar khrid bzhugs/ - PAGE 126 -- PAGE 127 -- PAGE 120 -
